cases.task: Design a desktop conversation surface for an agent that runs long coding tasks and streams activity.
rubric: Uses one coherent state model
Exposes Stop while working
Preserves a readable thread and stable composer
Avoids marketing composition and nested cards

cases.task: Add an approval request for a command that needs expanded permissions.
rubric: Separates Waiting from Approval
Names subject, reason, scope, and impact
Keeps Deny visible and one Allow action primary
Does not hide the decision in a toast

cases.task: Review the interrupted and failed states of an asynchronous agent task.
rubric: Preserves completed work, draft, queue, and position
Distinguishes Resume from Retry
Binds retry to an object and rollback scope
Separates render retry from task re-execution

cases.task: Design recovery after one queued message fails and a three-item batch has mixed results.
rubric: Leaves the failed queue item in place
Blocks later items until explicit resolution
Shows successful and failed scope together
Offers failed-only retry only when addressable and idempotent

cases.task: Add Review, Terminal, Browser, Files, and side-chat tools beside an existing agent thread.
rubric: Preserves originating thread context
Uses a compact launcher
Defines active tab, canvas, secondary navigation, and focus restore
Does not overbuild the framework for a single simple panel

cases.task: Review the sidebar, file tree, and empty Files workspace for scanning and repeated navigation.
rubric: Uses stable compact tracks
Keeps search close to the tree
Uses work-surface typography rather than a hero
Defines keyboard and narrow-width behavior

cases.task: Verify a streaming thread at 1920x1080 and at the narrowest supported layout.
rubric: Gives the user scroll ownership outside the follow zone
Preserves expansion anchors and per-thread position
Defines Escape layers and focus restoration
Collapses secondary panes before damaging primary content

cases.task: Review an agent UI using source code only because no browser runtime is available.
rubric: Does not claim runtime or screenshot verification
Separates static, synthetic, and observed evidence
Reports unverified states and residual risk
Defers to host-project code and design-system facts
